user.title: Jukebox
user.description: Adds the `announce` action, which plays a chime and a message on your Sonos speakers. Choose the rooms, the voice and quiet hours afterwards, under Configure.

pick_implementation.title: Sign Jukebox in to Spotify
pick_implementation.description: For listening to Spotify on a phone. Choose the application credentials to sign in with.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Jukebox is signed in to Spotify. The people who may run a party can now listen to Spotify on their own phone.
abort.reauth_successful: Jukebox is signed in to Spotify again.
abort.missing_credentials: Jukebox needs application credentials to sign in to Spotify. Add them under Settings, Devices & services, Application credentials, for Jukebox: the client ID and secret of the Spotify developer app that Home Assistant's Spotify integration uses.
abort.missing_configuration: Jukebox has no application credentials to sign in to Spotify with.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Spotify took too long to give the address to sign in at.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address that Spotify can send the sign-in back to. Set its address under Settings, System, Network.
abort.oauth_error: Spotify sent back a sign-in that couldn't be read.
abort.oauth_timeout: Spotify took too long to finish the sign-in.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Spotify refused the sign-in. Check the client ID and secret.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The sign-in was turned down on Spotify's page.

application_credentials.description: Jukebox signs in to Spotify itself, so that Spotify can be played on a phone. Enter the client ID and client secret of the Spotify developer app that Home Assistant's Spotify integration uses. That app needs the Web Playback SDK ticked among its APIs.

data_description.players: The Sonos speakers an announcement goes to when the action names none. Each gets a number for its announcement volume.
data_description.tts: The text-to-speech voice that says a message.
data_description.chime: The sound played before each announcement: a web address or a media id. Jukebox's own is filled in; empty the box for none.
data_description.quiet: While this is on, announcements are not played unless they have priority. A schedule helper suits it.
data_description.sidebar: Jukebox's own page, in Home Assistant's sidebar. Turn it off if you use a dashboard of your own made from Jukebox's cards. The page stays at /jukebox either way.
data_description.hosts: The logins that may turn the party lock on and off, change the music while it is on, and change the Sonos playlists at any time. Administrators always may.
data_description.screens: Logins of shared screens, such as wall tablets. They may save, change and delete Sonos playlists, except while a party is on anywhere in the house. During a party they can change the music only while someone who runs it has let them, and never the party itself. Any other login can only look, and can never change a playlist.

not_set_up.message: Jukebox isn't set up. Add it under Settings, Devices & services.

nothing_to_play.message: Give the announcement a message, a sound, or both.

no_voice.message: Jukebox has no voice to say a message with. Choose one in its Configure dialog.

no_players.message: No rooms to announce in. Name some in the action, or choose them in Jukebox's Configure dialog.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Jukebox

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Jukebox integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works. Restart Home Assistant to load it.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Plays a chime, then a sound, then a message, over whatever each room is playing, and puts nothing out of place. Announcements to one speaker are played one after another. The answer names each room's result.

message.name: Message
message.description: Words to say, with the voice chosen in Jukebox's Configure dialog.

media.name: Sound
media.description: A sound to play: a web address or a media id. Played before the message when both are given.

players.name: Rooms
players.description: The Sonos speakers to announce on. Leave it out for all the rooms chosen in the Configure dialog.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Whether the chime is played first.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: A volume for this announcement in every room, in place of each room's own announcement volume.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Play it in quiet hours too.

play.name: Play a favourite
play.description: Plays a Sonos favourite or playlist, by its name, in one or more rooms. It goes through Jukebox, so it is logged and a party doesn't put it back.

favourite.name: Favourite
favourite.description: The name of a favourite or a Sonos playlist, as it is written in Jukebox's Favourites.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: The Sonos speakers to play it on. With more than one, the first leads and the others join it.

enqueue.name: Where in the queue
enqueue.description: Leave it out to play now. A station always plays now.

options.add: Add to the end of the queue
